info.title: scrapio independent collectors and tasks
info.description: O1 collectors, O2 durable tasks/tables and O3 multi-stage graphs/dispatches are mounted under /api/v4. O4 finite sources, interval schedules, scoped replay and governance are mounted. Operations carry bounded polymorphic results; TestResult, SessionView and CollectorVersionView describe concrete projections. Real release verification pending.

get.description: Run and per-stage status, input/work counts, immutable outputs, save decisions, filtered/delivered/remaining dispatches and pause reason. Selected O5-01 adds per-stage input policy, source_count, actual input_count, merged_inputs and outgoing merged_dispatches. Merged is dispatch receipt status, never a synthetic work item or independent success. Each stage includes upstreams with edge, port and parent status; union input closes only after ALL parents terminate and drain their dispatch plans. Empty/failed/limited parents remain visible. Gather stages expose gather_sealed, buffered_rows and gather_counts. Sealed groups are durable before work is released; pending groups prevent stage completion.

post.description: New finite run from explicit stage and descendants. Original item inputs, historical output+mapping or confirmed table snapshot. Task version same task; retry_of and unexecuted stage scope retained; missing evidence blocks. No full regression claim. For historical outputs with multiple incoming edges, edge_id is required; a single edge defaults automatically. Only that edge maps the selected outputs. Excluded incoming edges are recorded in retry_scope. Shared descendants run with the retained sources only, not a whole-graph regression. Join/batch cannot replay a single upstream output; use complete historical inputs or a table snapshot. A pruned descendant barrier missing any required incoming branch is rejected.

post.description: Explicit frozen task version and source Schema; typed field mapping, 1..100 inputs per finite formal run. Initial backfill freezes at most1000 rows/4MiB with commit-ordered table watermark; future skips prior data. Source events are transactional created/updated effective rows; unchanged, trial, pass-through, deletes and direct SQL are excluded. Graph cycles including paused subscriptions rejected. At most20 retained subscriptions per owner; one retained subscription per task.

post.description: Revision CAS and original idempotency key. Pause preserves cursor and pending evidence; resume requires ready, unarchived task. Retire is terminal, releases unused backfill and retention protection; generated runs continue. Configuration is immutable: retire and explicitly recreate for a new version/mapping. Old changes retained at least30days, and indefinitely while any paused/blocked subscriber still needs them, within change-storage quota.

BoundedObject.description: O0 placeholder for projected response or bounded values. Byte limits are enforced outside JSON Schema.

input_policy.description: Optional; absent means keep_all. Merge only within one run and stage, using the complete normalized input and frozen collector version. All source snapshots retained. Shared outcome and one downstream delivery, including late sources.

input_mode.description: Single, streaming union, finite keyed join or finite batch barrier. Join/batch wait for every upstream success and drained outbox, within the immutable run; no time-window subscription.
